answer: Challenge-Bound Task Ledger. Each new agent must complete a task whose answer is derived from a live secret only the requester holds, and the answer must be unrepeatable: the ledger rejects any submission already recorded, so copies fail. The task’s verification path acts as a cipher keyed to that moment. Attackers pay by solving each task independently, and a reusable fable of past answers is worthless. Every attempt also requires fresh computation plus an ivory token deposit forfeited on duplicate submission.
